name: Collector-repulsor array
description: The collector-repulsor array, also referred to simply as the repulsor ray, was a superweapon under development by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. It would focus the G-waves of hundreds of repulsor projectors to distort planetary crusts, with cataclysmic results.

data.name: Collector-repulsor array
data.range: None; transported by a small starship
